source: Nommie from Cut the Rope 2 (ZeptoLab). Redrawn by the studio after an official CTR 2 App Store screenshot used as a shape reference for the generator (D-21); the official image is not part of the product.
createdBy: studio (art director), run 2026-09-30-offline-games, D-21 (replaces the D-17 version)
pivotNote: Unity pivot (y up) = feet, centre of the body bottom. Same canvas and pivot for every frame: swap sprites only. Same px-per-unit as Om Nom unity/ frames -> same PPU and scale gives the right height ratio (Toss 62 u vs Om Nom 72 u).
facing: left (3/4), like Om Nom; mirror with scaleX -1
anchorsNote: logical units, x right, y UP from the feet point, unmirrored (Toss faces the viewer's left). unityLocal = (x, y) * worldPerLogical; mirror x with scaleX -1
shadow: reuse Om Nom unity/shadow.png scaled to ~58 x 11 u
rules: the whole body is the spring: open hollow top rim + 3 thin rings above the face, wider at the bottom; no tail, no separate jelly body
springTipNote: springTip = top centre of the open rim (D-21: no tail any more)
